extracted.name: Air Fryer Sweet Potato Hash
extracted.description: Make this crispy, smoky sweet potato-bacon hash in your air fryer for a quick, new breakfast or brunch idea.
ingredient_lines: 2 large sweet potato, cut into small cubes
2 slices bacon, cut into small pieces
instruction_lines: Preheat an air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).

Toss sweet potato, bacon, olive oil, paprika, salt, pepper, and dill in a large bowl. Place mixture into the preheated air fryer. Cook for 12 to 16 minutes. Check and stir after 10 minutes and then every 3 minutes until crispy and browned.
